title: NLP meets psychotherapy: Using predicted client emotions and self-reported client emotions to measure emotional coherence
reasoning: The paper focuses on the application of NLP to measure emotional coherence in psychotherapy for clients' well-being. While psychotherapy involves ethical considerations in practice and the paper includes an 'Ethics Statement' regarding data collection, the core research does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary scientific objective. The 'well-being' aspect is psychological, not ethical in the sense of moral philosophy.
